title: Choose when deleted files give back storage
summary: Recently Deleted now shows how much storage your files use, what is waiting to leave and when, and lets you give storage back sooner for a folder, a kind of file, big files, or when storage passes a size.

payload.title: Your storage at a glance
payload.body: At the top of Recently Deleted: what you keep, what is deleted and waiting, and a chart of storage over the next days as it leaves.

payload.title: Rules of your own
payload.body: Add a rule to give storage back sooner, for example camera proxies after 1 day, or the oldest deleted files while storage is above 500 GB. Your AI can set the same rules, and your schedules can run them.
